name: Radish

basicInfo.description: Radishes are one of the fastest-growing vegetables, ready to harvest in less than a month. Perfect for beginners and great for adding a peppery crunch to salads.
whyGrow: Super fast harvest – ready in 3–4 weeks
Low-maintenance and grows in small spaces
Adds fresh, peppery flavor to dishes
Great starter crop for kids and beginners
basicInfo.sunlight: 4–6 hours of sun daily (can tolerate partial shade)
basicInfo.water: Keep soil evenly moist to avoid woody or bitter roots

growingSteps: Prepare loose, well-drained soil with compost
Thin seedlings to 5–10cm spacing once they sprout
Keep soil moist for rapid growth
Harvest radishes when roots are 2–3cm in diameter

careCalendar.description: Directly sow radish seeds into soil 1cm deep.
Remove extra seedlings to leave 5–10cm between plants.
Keep soil moist to avoid woody or cracked roots.
Pull radishes when roots reach 2–3cm in size.

symptoms: Big leafy tops but tiny roots

harvestingGuide: Harvest radishes 3–4 weeks after sowing when roots are about 2–3cm across. Don’t wait too long, or they become woody. Pull gently from the soil by the tops.
estimatedSavings: Growing radishes can save $20–40 per season since store-bought bunches cost $2–3 each, but homegrown radishes are plentiful and cheap.
